channelTitle: Point Pleasant 1966 - the red-eyed thing that warned the town - Part 1
hook: November 1966, a small West Virginia town: five men digging a grave looked up and saw a man with wings and glowing red eyes - and it never left them alone.
storyParts: Point Pleasant was a quiet river town until that cold November night - gravediggers at the old cemetery saw a seven-foot figure unfold giant wings and lift off without a sound.

The sightings kept coming. Two couples driving past the abandoned explosives plant saw the same thing: red eyes like bicycle reflectors, wings ten feet wide, and it chased their car at a hundred miles an hour.

The town split in two. Some swore it was a government experiment, others said an owl, others whispered curse. But everyone agreed on one thing - it watched you, and it felt like it knew something you didn't.
The sheriff's phone rang every night. Dogs went missing. TV sets hissed. And through it all, the winged figure kept appearing on rooftops - always near something about to go wrong.
Then came December 15, 1967 - rush hour, the Silver Bridge packed with Christmas shoppers, humming with holiday traffic. Nobody understood yet that the whole year's warnings were about that bridge.
cta: What happened on the Silver Bridge at 5 pm that day? Part 2 is in the Mothman playlist.
moral: Sometimes the monster is not the threat - it is the warning nobody wanted to hear.
seriesTitle: The Mothman Warnings - Grandma June Stories
